'''Mt. Silver Base Summit''' is the peak of [[Mt. Silver]].

After dealing with the Space-Time distortions caused by the Palkia/Dialga/Giratina [[Triple Fusions|Triple Fusion]], a vortex will appear, taking the player a few years into the future to have a fight with Gold, as throwback to the fight they had in [[bulbapedia:Mt. Silver|Pokémon Gold & Silver]].

After defeating Gold, the player will be transported back into their own time, but in their room in [[Pallet Town]], where their Mom will give a Shiny Charm.
